module "ExternLayer.dss"

product 0 Material "M_LiExternLayer" backend=Graph
  %0 = Constant(Value=(1, 0, 0)) : float3 @L11:C19 "BaseColor"
  %1 = MakeMaterialAttributes(BaseColor=%0) : material @L12:C5
  %2 = FunctionCall[/Game/Layers/ML_LiExternal](m=%1, FunctionPath="/Game/Layers/ML_LiExternal") : [m:material] @L12:C5
  %3 = Constant(Value=(0, 1, 0)) : float3 @L14:C24 "BaseColor"
  %4 = Constant(Value=(0, 0, 1)) : float3 @L16:C21 "BaseColor"
  %5 = MakeMaterialAttributes(BaseColor=%3) : material @L17:C5
  %6 = MakeMaterialAttributes(BaseColor=%4) : material @L17:C5
  %7 = FunctionCall[/Game/Layers/MLB_LiExternal](A=%5, B=%6, R=%2, FunctionPath="/Game/Layers/MLB_LiExternal") : [R:material] @L17:C5
  %8 = GetMaterialAttributes(MaterialAttributes=%7) : [BaseColor:float3, EmissiveColor:float3, Roughness:float, Normal:float3, Opacity:float, WorldPositionOffset:float3, FrontMaterial:Substrate, MaterialAttributes:material] @L18:C17 "Opacity"
  %9 = SetMaterialAttributes(MaterialAttributes=%7, Opacity=%8#2, AttributeSetTypes="[Opacity]") : material @L9:C1
  %10 = MaterialSink(MaterialAttributes=%9) @L9:C1
  sink %10
